Trang: Cobblemon on iOS: can you play Cobblemon on iPhone and iPad?
URL: https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-ios/

# Cobblemon on iPhone and iPad (iOS)

There is no official Cobblemon app on the App Store, and Cobblemon does not run in Minecraft PE (Bedrock) on iPhone, because Cobblemon is a mod for Minecraft Java Edition. To play real Cobblemon on an iPhone or iPad you need a launcher that runs Minecraft Java Edition, installed from outside the App Store. The Coco Cobblemon server has **CocoLauncher iOS**, an experimental build for joining the server from iPhone and iPad.

## Your options

| Option | What it is | Real Cobblemon? |
|---|---|---|
| Apps named "Cobblemon" on the App Store | Minecraft PE add-ons or other third-party apps, not the Cobblemon mod | No |
| CocoLauncher iOS | Runs Minecraft Java Edition and downloads the game and the Coco Cobblemon mod pack. Experimental, only for joining Coco Cobblemon | Yes |
| Other Java launchers for iOS, such as Amethyst (based on PojavLauncher) | Run Minecraft Java Edition; you install Fabric and Cobblemon yourself | Yes, with your own mod setup |

CocoLauncher iOS is a modified version of Angel Aura Amethyst, open source under GPLv3 ([github.com/Coconubs/CocoLauncher-iOS](https://github.com/Coconubs/CocoLauncher-iOS)).

## What you need for CocoLauncher iOS

| Need | Details |
|---|---|
| Device | iPhone or iPad on iOS 14 or later. 8 GB of RAM recommended (iPhone 15 Pro, 16, 17); 6 GB devices run on the Low preset |
| Game memory | The memory unlock is required. 8 GB devices need at least 3.5 GB (3.8-4 GB runs smoothly), 6 GB devices 2.5 GB |
| Computer | A Windows PC or Mac with a cable, once, for about 30 minutes (unless you already have your own IPA signing certificate) |
| Account | An Apple ID; a secondary one is recommended. A free Apple ID can sideload 3 apps: SideStore, CocoLauncher and StikDebug |
| Network | The first start downloads about 1.5 GB, so use Wi-Fi |

## Main steps

The detailed steps differ between iOS 26 and earlier and iOS 27, and can change with app updates. Follow the [CocoLauncher iOS page](https://coconubs.github.io/CocoLauncher-iOS/) (in Vietnamese); this is a summary so you know what to expect.

1. **On the computer (once):** install iTunes from apple.com and iloader, connect the iPhone, use iloader to install SideStore, then import the CocoLauncher IPA. Installing through iloader gives the app the increased memory permission.
2. **On the iPhone:** trust your Apple ID in Settings, turn on Developer Mode, install LocalDevVPN (free on the App Store) and StikDebug. StikDebug enables JIT; without JIT, Minecraft Java cannot run on iPhone.
3. **Open CocoLauncher:** if it asks to unlock memory, sign in with the same Apple ID you used for SideStore. Enter a player name (3-16 characters: letters without accents, digits, underscore) and press **CHƠI** (Play).
4. **Join:** open Multiplayer, pick the Coco server, then register (first time) or log in on the screen that appears.

## Every session and every 7 days

- **Every session:** turn on Wi-Fi, connect LocalDevVPN, open CocoLauncher and press Play. The app turns on JIT through StikDebug and comes back. Once JIT is on, you can switch to mobile data.
- **Every 7 days:** open SideStore, My Apps, Refresh All (Wi-Fi and LocalDevVPN needed). If it expires, the app will not open until you refresh.
- When the server's mod pack changes, the app downloads only the changes.

Do not install with shared or enterprise certificates or SideInstaller: they get revoked often, and the app cannot enable JIT, so it will not run. KSign and ESign only work with your own Development certificate.

## Quick answers

### Is Cobblemon on the App Store?

There is no official version. The Cobblemon team only makes a mod for Minecraft Java Edition. Apps named "Cobblemon" on the App Store are Minecraft PE add-ons or other third-party apps.

### Can Minecraft PE on iPhone run Cobblemon?

No. Minecraft PE is the Bedrock edition, and Cobblemon only runs on Java Edition.

### Do I need a computer to play Cobblemon on iPhone?

Once, for about 30 minutes, to install SideStore and CocoLauncher (unless you have your own IPA signing certificate). After that you play on the iPhone and refresh the app in SideStore every 7 days.

### Which iPhones work?

iOS 14 or later. 8 GB of RAM is recommended, such as iPhone 15 Pro, 16 or 17; 6 GB devices run on the Low preset.

**See also:** [Play Cobblemon on Android and iPhone](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-android/) · [Cobblemon server in Vietnam](https://coconubs.github.io/en/vietnam-cobblemon-server/) · [How to join](https://coconubs.github.io/en/how-to-join/) · [FAQ](https://coconubs.github.io/en/faq/)

Trang: Cobblemon Bedrock and PE: is Cobblemon on Bedrock Edition?
URL: https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-bedrock/

# Cobblemon on Bedrock and Pocket Edition

Short answer: official Cobblemon only exists for Minecraft Java Edition, running on Fabric or NeoForge. Packs called "Cobblemon PE", "Cobblemon Bedrock" or "Cobblemon MCPE" are add-ons that other people remade for Bedrock, not releases from the Cobblemon team.

## Which Minecraft editions run official Cobblemon

| Minecraft edition | Official Cobblemon |
|---|---|
| Java Edition on Windows, macOS, Linux | Yes, through Fabric or NeoForge |
| Java Edition on Android, through a Java launcher | Runs if the device is powerful enough |
| Bedrock, Pocket Edition (PE) on phones, Windows, consoles | No |

Cobblemon downloads are on Modrinth and CurseForge. On Modrinth, the newest release when this page was written is Cobblemon 1.8.4 for Minecraft 1.21.1, released on 27 October 2026.

## What "Cobblemon PE" add-ons are

Minecraft PE add-on sites list many packs named Cobblemon. They are Bedrock add-ons based on the idea of Cobblemon:

- They are not made by the Cobblemon team. Pokémon, menus and mechanics differ from the Java mod.
- They cannot join Cobblemon servers that run on Java Edition, such as Coco Cobblemon, because a Java server needs the actual Cobblemon mod on the player's side.
- Only download from sites you trust. Unknown add-on sites often bundle ads or fake files.

## Playing Cobblemon on a phone

The way to play real Cobblemon on a phone is to run Minecraft Java Edition through a Java launcher:

- **Fold Craft Launcher (FCL), PojavLauncher:** run Java Edition on Android; you install Fabric and Cobblemon yourself. Good for playing alone or joining a server of your choice.
- **CocoLauncher Android:** an experimental build made only for joining the Coco Cobblemon server. It installs the Coco Lite pack (about 125 mods) for you and needs 6 GB of RAM or more, 8 GB or more recommended. See [Play Cobblemon on Android](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-android/).

## Is there a Cobblemon server for PE players?

Cobblemon servers run Java Edition, so the Minecraft PE app cannot join them. If an Android phone is powerful enough, players can join Coco Cobblemon (`coco.ultramc.co`, Minecraft Java 1.21.1) with CocoLauncher Android and play together with PC players. Server details are on the [Cobblemon server in Vietnam](https://coconubs.github.io/en/vietnam-cobblemon-server/) page.

## Quick answers

### Is Cobblemon on Bedrock?

No. Cobblemon is a mod for Minecraft Java Edition only. Packs named Cobblemon for Bedrock or PE are add-ons made by other people, not Cobblemon.

### Where can I download Cobblemon for Minecraft PE?

There is no official PE version. Packs named Cobblemon for PE are other people's add-ons, not the Cobblemon mod.

### Can Cobblemon PE join the Coco Cobblemon server?

No. Coco Cobblemon is a Minecraft Java 1.21.1 server running Cobblemon 1.7.3 with its own mod set, joined with CocoLauncher on Windows, macOS or Android.

### Does Minecraft PE have Pokémon?

There are a few community-made Pokémon add-ons for Bedrock. Cobblemon and Pixelmon are mods for Java Edition.

Trang: Best launcher for Cobblemon: Modrinth App, CurseForge, Prism, CocoLauncher
URL: https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-launcher/

# Which launcher for Cobblemon? Modrinth App, CurseForge, Prism Launcher, CocoLauncher

Cobblemon is a mod for Minecraft Java Edition, so you need a launcher that can install mods. Pick by what you want to do: play alone, join a server, or play on a phone.

## Quick pick

| You want to | Use |
|---|---|
| Play Cobblemon on your own | Modrinth App with the Cobblemon Official Modpack |
| Use modpacks from CurseForge | CurseForge App |
| Manage many installs and versions yourself | Prism Launcher |
| Join the Coco Cobblemon server | CocoLauncher |
| Play on Android or iPhone | CocoLauncher Android or CocoLauncher iOS (experimental, for the Coco server only) |

## The launchers

**Modrinth App.** Free, for Windows, macOS and Linux. Search for the Cobblemon Official Modpack in the Modpacks tab and press Install; the app downloads the right Minecraft, Fabric and dependency mods. A good start for new players playing alone.

**CurseForge App.** Free, with many community Cobblemon modpacks. Handy if you already use CurseForge for other mods.

**Prism Launcher.** Open source, for Windows, macOS and Linux, and it imports modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge. Good if you like to tune each install; new players will see more options than they need.

**CocoLauncher.** The launcher of the Coco Cobblemon server, for Windows (Microsoft Store), macOS, and experimental Android and iPhone builds. Enter a name and press **Play**; it installs Java, Minecraft, Fabric and the server's mod set, and keeps the mods in step with the server. CocoLauncher only joins Coco Cobblemon; it is not for single player or other servers. Downloads are on the [main page](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cocolauncher/).

## Joining a server

Every Cobblemon server needs its exact Minecraft version, Cobblemon version and mod set. A general launcher such as Modrinth App can join a server that publishes its modpack; when a server has its own launcher, that is usually the least trouble. Coco Cobblemon runs Minecraft Java 1.21.1, Fabric and Cobblemon 1.7.3 with its own mod set, so use CocoLauncher.

## Why the official Cobblemon modpack cannot join Coco Cobblemon

On Modrinth, the latest Cobblemon Official Modpack [Fabric] is version 1.8.4, released on 27 October 2026, which comes with Cobblemon 1.8. Coco Cobblemon runs Cobblemon 1.7.3 plus the server's own mods (Vietnamese menu, Ranked Battles, guilds and more). Your Cobblemon version and mods have to match the server, so the official modpack is refused when it tries to join. CocoLauncher downloads the exact mod set the server uses and updates it when the server changes.

The same applies to any Cobblemon server: before joining, check which Minecraft and Cobblemon versions it runs and whether it has its own launcher or modpack.

## Cobblemon launchers on Android

Modrinth App, CurseForge App and Prism Launcher have no Android version. On Android, launchers that run Minecraft Java Edition, such as Fold Craft Launcher (FCL) or PojavLauncher, need you to install Fabric and every mod yourself. CocoLauncher Android is an experimental build made only for Coco Cobblemon: it installs the Coco Lite pack (about 125 mods) and needs 6 GB of RAM or more, 8 GB recommended. See [Play Cobblemon on Android](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-android/). iPhone and iPad have an experimental CocoLauncher iOS build for the same server; setup needs a computer once, see [iPhone and iPad](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-android/#iphone-and-ipad).

## Quick answers

### Can any of these install Cobblemon on Bedrock or Pocket Edition?

No. Cobblemon is a Java Edition mod, see [Cobblemon on Bedrock and PE](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-bedrock/). On Android, CocoLauncher Android is an experimental build that runs Java Edition to join Coco Cobblemon, see [Play Cobblemon on Android](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-android/).

### Do they cost anything?

Modrinth App, CurseForge App, Prism Launcher and CocoLauncher are all free to download.

*Updated: 11 November 2026.*

Trang: CocoLauncher troubleshooting: exit code 1, SmartScreen, macOS, Android
URL: https://coconubs.github.io/en/troubleshooting/

# CocoLauncher troubleshooting

Known problems and fixes by operating system. If yours is not here, ask on [Discord](https://discord.gg/hyspace) with a screenshot.

## Windows

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| SmartScreen blocks the installer | Install from the [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NPG31VS7T2H?cid=docs-en), or compare the SHA-256 hash before running the .exe |
| The launcher says the game exited with code 1 right after Play | The game stopped before loading mods. The case seen so far was a full disk: free up space and try again. Details are in `instance/logs/launcher-game-output.log` in the game folder |
| Slow game or crashes | Adjust RAM in the launcher's quick settings and close other apps |
| A mod breaks after copying files by hand | Remove that mod from the SideMods folder and press Play. The launcher re-checks the modpack on every launch |
| Version mismatch or missing mods when joining | Reopen CocoLauncher and press Play so it downloads the update. Do not join with another launcher |

## macOS

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| macOS cannot verify the developer | macOS 15 and later: System Settings > Privacy & Security, press Open Anyway. macOS 14 and earlier: Control-click the app, choose Open |
| The app "is damaged" | Download the file again from the [download page](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cocolauncher/) and compare the SHA-256 hash. If it still fails, ask on Discord; do not disable macOS security checks |
| A new version is out but the launcher does not update | Expected on Mac: download the new .dmg and drag it over the old app, your game data stays |

## Android

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| Emulator crashes | Use the emulator build (GiaLap.apk), not the phone build |
| Black screen or crash | In Settings, if the renderer is on Auto, try LTW or Zink |
| Hot phone, stutter | Lower the resolution to 50-70% |
| Crashes mid-game | Keep game memory at the recommended level, close other apps |
| The .apk download sits at 100% | Pull down the notification shade, Chrome is waiting for you to keep the file |

**See also:** [FAQ](https://coconubs.github.io/en/faq/) · [CocoLauncher download](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cocolauncher/) · [Play on Android and iPhone](https://coconubs.github.io/en/cobblemon-android/) · [How to join](https://coconubs.github.io/en/how-to-join/)
